response.rationale: The item is electronics with days_since_delivery of 16, which exceeds the 15-day electronics return window. RET-003 (priority 20) applies and controls over the standard 30-day window rule RET-007 (priority 10). No higher-priority rule applies: final_sale is false (RET-012 inapplicable), defective is null (RET-020 inapplicable), and goodwill_grant/fraud_hold are false (RET-050/RET-051 inapplicable).
